runs.emptyCta: Set up CI for an agent
runs.emptyHint: Runs appear after the workflow has run on a pull request and you refresh, or within a minute while this page is open.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

reason.secretsUnavailable: Secrets were not available to this run (for example a fork pull request).
reason.resultExpired: The result artifact expired on GitHub before it was pulled.
reason.too_large: Result rejected: the artifact is larger than 1 MiB.
reason.schema: Result rejected: the artifact does not match the expected format.
reason.repository_mismatch: Result rejected: the artifact names a different repository.
reason.sha_mismatch: Result rejected: the commit in the artifact does not match the workflow run.
reason.agent_inactive: Result rejected: this agent is not active in CI for this repository.
reason.workflow_modified: Result rejected: the workflow was modified after it was installed.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.slugNote: Files for this agent live under {dir} and the workflow is {workflow}.
exportWizard.yamlWarningSecrets: The workflow no longer references OPENROUTER_API_KEY, so the review cannot run.
exportWizard.yamlWarningPermissions: The workflow requests broader permissions than DevDigest generates.
exportWizard.regenerateBody: Your edits to the workflow will be replaced by a freshly generated version.
exportWizard.memoryDesc: Include .devdigest/agents/{slug}/memory.jsonl so the CI agent starts with what it has learned.
exportWizard.blockMergeNote: To block merges: set {failOn} (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then add a {requiredCheck} in the repo’s GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App needed.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo’s Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.secretNoteAc23: The key is stored by GitHub and is never shown to DevDigest. Add it under Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “{title}” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.runnerMissing: The runner bundle is missing. Build it with: {command}

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.emptyBody: Deploy this agent to run automatically on every pull request in a repo's CI pipeline.

failOn.title: Fail CI on
failOn.desc: Exit non-zero when a finding at or above this severity lands. Pair with a required status check to block merges.

ciTab.policyChanged: Fail CI on changed since export
ciTab.removeConfirmBody: DevDigest opens a pull request that deletes the workflow and the agent files. CI stops after it is merged.
ciTab.removedDirectly: Removed directly — the install PR was never merged. Close the install PR if it is still open.
ciTab.loadError: Could not load the CI status
